release.cap_rule: below the global minimum every performance job is capped at L0_descriptive regardless of point estimates (header section 6)
release.l2_l3_note: L2 needs L1 plus >= 126 post-2026-11-11 sessions under this header hash; L3 is never assignable by this harness

comparators.label: Simple participation (SPY above 200-day average, else cash)
comparators.definition: 100% SPY if SPY adjusted close(t) > its 200-session simple moving average(t) else 100% BIL; evaluated daily; executed t+1

comparators.label: Sector allocation only (top-3 sector ETFs)
comparators.definition: equal weight (1/3) in the top 3 of XLB XLC XLE XLF XLI XLK XLP XLRE XLU XLV XLY by RS63 = 63-session total return minus SPY 63-session total return; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Member selection only (sector-neutral S&P 1500 names)
comparators.definition: S&P 1500 PIT members at t (start_date<=t<end_date or open), sector label present, >=126 valid closes, raw close>=5; score = 63-session total return minus own sector SPDR 63-session total return; per sector take top k=max(3,ceil(0.10*n_s)) equal weight; sector weights fixed = non-negative least squares style weights of SPY daily returns on the 11 SPDRs over the 252 sessions ending 2026-08-07, normalised to 1; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Joint sector + member (top-3 sectors x top names)
comparators.definition: C3's top-3 sectors (1/3 each); within each, C4's top-k members by C4 score, equal weight; rebalance every 21 sessions

comparators.label: Incumbent Prophet book, as built
comparators.definition: index.json plans with selection_era == anticipation-v1-2026-08-08; publication session P = first session s with s > price_basis_date and s >= recorded_at; entered iff entry_zone_state.state in {filled, converted} and ledger outcome != NO_ENTRY; entry session E = first session >= max(P, filled_date if present); exit X = ledger close_date (last session <= close_date) when the plan is in the ledger, else first session after E with raw close <= invalidation or raw close >= targets[0] or date >= price_basis_date + horizon_days calendar days, else censored at window end; if X <= E the position is excluded (resolved_at_or_before_follower_fill); book = equal weight across open positions, re-equalised daily, 100% BIL when none

comparators.label: Prophet plans outside leading sectors
comparators.definition: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR is NOT in C3-rule top-3 computed at the close of price_basis_date

comparators.label: Prophet plans inside leading sectors (diagnostic)
comparators.definition: C6 restricted to plans whose sector SPDR IS in that top-3 (diagnostic counterpart to C7)

comparators.label: SPY/cash at Prophet's own invested weight (reference)
comparators.definition: daily weight w(t-1) in SPY and 1-w(t-1) in BIL where w is C6's risky weight at the previous close

contrasts.family: confirmatory K1-K8, Holm alpha 0.05, one-sided (a beats b)

secondary_contrasts.family: admission_class strata vs SPY, Holm alpha 0.05

exposure_matched_reference.definition: daily weight w(t-1) in SPY and 1-w(t-1) in BIL where w is C6's risky weight at the previous close

C6_exact_incumbent_prophet.linking: unlinked arithmetic sum of daily contributions; compounding residual shown

C7_independent_emergence.linking: unlinked arithmetic sum of daily contributions; compounding residual shown

C6A_context_aligned_prophet.linking: unlinked arithmetic sum of daily contributions; compounding residual shown

event_study.ruler: engine.grading.forward_metrics next-bar fill; fixed horizons in sessions; policy-free
event_study.population: all incumbent-era plans with a publication session in the window (entered or not)

post_hoc_diagnostics.label: POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE_DIAGNOSTIC (not in the frozen header; cannot change any release level)

rebounds.reason: window holds no SPY drawdown deep enough for a rebound test (see window.spy_max_drawdown)

issuer_excluded_peers.reason: listing-ticker identity only; no issuer master join in this harness, so issuer-excluded peer counts are not supportable

observed_relative_performance.basis: realised window returns with bootstrap CIs; L0 only

estimated_exposure_residual.basis: OLS beta/intercept on 63 daily returns; not a validated factor model

participation_attribution.basis: equal-weight model book of published plans; not actual holdings or user portfolios

incremental_selection_value.basis: sample below the predeclared L1 minimum

limitations: Short sample: one 64-session window (SPY -4.6 pp); no rebound or crash regime was observed.
Annualised differentials from 63 daily returns are very noisy; read total-window differences and their intervals.
S&P 1500 point-in-time membership has no recorded change after 2026-06-02; 36 point-in-time members had no price file and were excluded.
Sector labels are current-basis GICS, not the classification in force at each date.

Prophet plans are read from the 2026-11-09 plan snapshot, not each plan's as-published bytes; entries use the publication clock and close-only fills, so results differ from the plan record's own same-bar outcomes.
Model book: equal weight across open published plans. It is not user holdings, a portfolio recommendation or sizing advice.
The event-study date-cluster intervals treat publication dates as independent although nearby dates share overlapping market paths, so those intervals are likely too narrow.
Issuer-excluded peer counts are unavailable: identity is the listing ticker only.
The eight catalog sleeves cannot be evaluated: plans carry no sleeve link. admission_class strata are reported instead.

deviations.what: reason/key names derived from 'ledger' renamed to 'recorded_*' / 'resolution_log'
deviations.why: lane-8 validator forbids key substrings incl. 'edge' (contained in 'ledger'); no method change

deviations.what: post_hoc_diagnostics: per-asset contribution concentration, concurrent position counts, Prophet books re-run without their single largest contributor
deviations.why: the C6 book's result was visibly driven by one name; disclosed as descriptive only, cannot change any release level or threshold

deviations.what: the last scheduled rule rebalance (decision 2026-11-05) executes at the final close 2026-11-06; its trading cost has no following return day and is not charged
deviations.why: header schedule executes while t+1 <= last close; omitted cost is at most one rebalance (< 0.1 pp for C3-C5)

deviations.what: event-study horizons with fewer than 5 distinct publication dates are marked status=too_few_dates
deviations.why: H=63 matured for a single publication date; a one-cluster bootstrap interval is degenerate and must not be displayed as uncertainty

headline: Release level: descriptive only (L0). The window is 64 sessions; the predeclared minimum for any accepted historical claim is 252 sessions including an 8% market drawdown.
Market over the window: SPY -4.6 pp total return, deepest drawdown -5.9 pp.
Incumbent Prophet book (as built, 510 positions): +1.0 pp net, +5.6 pp versus SPY, 95% CI [-9.9, +23.0] pp. The interval includes zero.
Beta capture: beta 0.81 (95% CI 0.63 to 1.14), mean invested weight 100%; upside capture 1.13, downside capture 0.83.
Without its largest single contributor (MRNA) the book is +2.1 pp versus SPY (CI [-10.3, +14.8] pp).

Published plans held for a fixed 21 sessions without Prophet's exits differed from SPY by -2.7 pp on average (date-cluster CI [-4.8, -0.6] pp); most of that gap was the stock versus its own sector ETF, not the sector choice.
Sector rotation alone, sector-neutral member selection alone and their combination did not beat SPY (K3 -3.9 pp/yr, K4 -3.8 pp/yr, K5 -7.6 pp/yr annualised; none significant after Holm).

Prophet plans inside leading sectors did better than plans outside them in this window (K7 +41.8 pp/yr annualised, Holm p 1.00); this is not significant and its largest contributor is the same single name.
Nothing here shows that sector context or member selection adds value beyond market participation.
